mn61:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
mn61:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā rāhulo ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharati.
mn61:2.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena ambalaṭṭhikā yenāyasmā rāhulo tenupasaṅkami.
mn61:2.3: addasā kho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn61:2.7: āyasmāpi kho rāhulo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn61:3.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ udakādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi
mn61:3.2: ‘passasi no tvaṃ rāhula imaṃ parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ udakādhāne ṭhapita’nti. evambhante,
mn61:3.4: kho rāhula tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ natthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjāti.
mn61:4.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ chaḍḍetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi
mn61:4.2: passasi no tvaṃ rāhula taṃ parittaṃ udakāvasesaṃ chaḍḍita’nti.

mn61:5.2: passasi no tvaṃ rāhula imaṃ udakādhānaṃ nikkujjita’nti.
mn61:5.4: evaṃ nikkujjitaṃ kho rāhula tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, yesaṃ natthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjāti.

mn61:6.2: passasi no tvaṃ rāhula imaṃ udakādhānaṃ rittaṃ tucchanti.

mn61:7.1: seyyathāpi rāhula rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro. so saṅgāmagato purimehipi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehipi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, purimenapi kāyena kammaṃ karoti, pacchimenapi kāyena kammaṃ karoti, sīsenapi kammaṃ karoti, kaṇṇehipi kammaṃ karoti, dantehipi kammaṃ karoti, naṅguṭṭhenapi kammaṃ karoti, rakkhateva soṇḍaṃ.
mn61:7.3: ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehipi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehipi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, purimenapi kāyena kammaṃ karoti, pacchimenapi kāyena kammaṃ karoti, sīsenapi kammaṃ karoti, kaṇṇehipi kammaṃ karoti, dantehipi kammaṃ karoti, naṅguṭṭhenapi kammaṃ karoti, rakkhateva soṇḍaṃ,
mn61:7.5: yato kho rāhula rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro saṅgāmagato …pe… naṅguṭṭhenapi kammaṃ karoti. soṇḍāyapi kammaṃ karoti. tattha hatthārohassa evaṃ hoti:
mn61:7.6: ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto ubbūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgāmāvacaro saṅgāmagato …pe… naṅguṭṭhenapi kammaṃ karoti. soṇḍāyapi kammaṃ karoti.
mn61:7.9: evameva kho rāhula yassa kassaci sampajānamusāvāde natthi lajjā, nāhaṃ tassa kiñci pāpaṃ akaraṇīyanti vadāmi.
mn61:7.10: tasmātiha rāhula hassāpi na musā bhaṇissāmī’ti
mn61:8.4: evameva kho rāhula paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyena kammaṃ kātabbaṃ, paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā vācāya kammaṃ kātabbaṃ, paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā manasā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ
mn61:9.1: yadeva tvaṃ rāhula kāyena kammaṃ kattukāmo ahosi tadeva te kāyakammaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:

mn61:9.7: sace pana tvaṃ rāhula paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jāneyyāsi:
